_comment: Third-party components that do not carry their own license metadata. Python packages are collected automatically from the engines by scripts/collect-licenses.py; everything else is listed here. Texts are paths relative to this folder, or engine:<path> for a file inside the bundled engine. Keep versions in step with the engine — collect-licenses.py checks that every library listed under 'files' is present.
groups: Libraries bundled with the geometry kernel

components.notice: CADVERT makes use of facilities provided by the Open CASCADE Technology software. Open CASCADE Technology is included unmodified, as separate dynamically linked libraries, under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 with the Open CASCADE exception. Its complete source code is available at https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT (release V7_9_3). On request to admin@conviviumllc.com, we will provide a copy of the source code of any LGPL-licensed library included in CADVERT.
